summary: The main article describes a photoredox catalytic method for the trifluoromethylation and perfluoroalkylation of (hetero)arenes using trifluoroacetic acid and related carboxylic acids. It includes 4 figures detailing the working hypothesis, reaction optimization, and the substrate scope for various fluoroalkyl groups.

items.heading: Figure 1. Working Hypothesis for the Trifluoromethylation
items.caption: (A) Direct oxidative pathway: generation of trifluoromethyl radical under harsh conditions. (B) This work: generation of trifluoromethyl radical via visible light photoredox catalysis.
